message:
We all have that one friend who panics at the slightest hint of trouble—like when the weather app shows a 10% chance of rain, and they start prepping for a monsoon! 🌧️ It’s easy to roll our eyes, but they remind us of something important: being ready doesn’t mean living in fear; it means being prepared so we can enjoy life, no matter what comes our way. 

The next time we chat, let's share a few simple tips on what we keep in our go-bags or how we organize important documents. It’s always good to be a little more prepared, without the panic! What’s your favorite tip for staying calm and ready?
